fs-wf-checks.front: The 4 checks before a fire season hunt?
fs-wf-checks.back: Fire map, area restriction orders, fire bans, air quality (AQHI).

fs-wf-area.front: What does an area restriction order mean for a hunter?
fs-wf-area.back: No entering or staying inside without written authorization, for any purpose, including hunting.

fs-wf-evac.front: Evacuation order lifted. Area restriction still on. Hunt?
fs-wf-evac.back: No. Restrictions can outlast evacuation orders.

fs-wf-ticket.front: Ticket for entering a restricted area?
fs-wf-ticket.back: Fire centre notices cite $1,150 violation tickets.

fs-wf-uphill.front: Which way does fire spread fastest?
fs-wf-uphill.back: Uphill. Rising heat pre heats the fuel above.

fs-wf-traps.back: Upslopes, chimneys (narrow draws), saddles, heavy dry timber.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Fire traps in terrain: upslope, where fire races up; chimneys, narrow draws that funnel fire; saddles, where wind funnels; and heavy dry timber. Escape downhill, sideways, or into ground that has already burned, the black.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Fire traps in the terrain</text><rect x="20" y="48" width="170" height="82" rx="10" fill="#fbe9e7" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="105" y="84" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Upslope</text><text x="105" y="108" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">fire races up</text><rect x="210" y="48" width="170" height="82" rx="10" fill="#fbe9e7" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="295" y="84" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Chimney</text><text x="295" y="108" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">narrow draw</text><rect x="20" y="144" width="170" height="82" rx="10" fill="#fbe9e7" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="105" y="180" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Saddle</text><text x="105" y="204" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">wind funnels</text><rect x="210" y="144" width="170" height="82" rx="10" fill="#fbe9e7" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="295" y="180" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Heavy fuel</text><text x="295" y="204" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">thick dry timber</text><rect x="20" y="250" width="361" height="30" rx="6" fill="#2e7d32"/><text x="200" y="271" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">Escape: down, sideways, into the black</text>

fs-wf-cornered.back: Bare ground, lie face down low with feet toward the flames, cover mouth and nose until it passes.

fs-wf-ash.front: Ash and sparks falling on you mean?
fs-wf-ash.back: The fire is probably close, within about 1.6 km.

fs-wf-report.back: 1 800 663 5555 toll free, or *5555 on a cell.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Hunters can start fires too: hot exhaust from a truck or ATV parked on dry grass, cigarette butts in grass, a campfire not fully out, and sparks from dragging chains or metal.   <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Hunters can start fires too</text><rect x="30" y="46" width="340" height="44" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="74" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Hot exhaust</text><text x="200" y="74" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">truck, ATV on dry grass</text><rect x="30" y="98" width="340" height="44" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="126" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Smoking</text><text x="200" y="126" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">butts in grass</text><rect x="30" y="150" width="340" height="44" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="178" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Campfire</text><text x="200" y="178" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">not fully out</text><rect x="30" y="202" width="340" height="44" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="230" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Chains, sparks</text><text x="200" y="230" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">dragging metal</text><rect x="33" y="258" width="334" height="30" rx="6" fill="#c0392b"/><text x="200" y="279" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">See a fire: 1 800 663 5555 or *5555</text>
</svg>

fs-wf-exhaust.front: How can a hunter start a wildfire by parking?
fs-wf-exhaust.back: Hot exhaust on dry grass. Park on gravel or dirt.

fs-wf-burn.back: Danger trees, ash pits with smouldering roots, loose rock, flash floods.

fs-wf-aqhi10.front: AQHI 10+: what should a hunter do?
fs-wf-aqhi10.back: Reduce or reschedule strenuous activity like a hard climb. People at higher risk avoid it.

fs-wf-n95.front: Mask for wildfire smoke if you cannot get to cleaner air?
